candidates.text: Under the Appropriations Clause, an appropriation is simply a law that authorizes expenditures from a specified source of public money for designated purposes
candidates.speaker: Thomas
phrases: an appropriation is simply a law that authorizes expenditures
candidates.reason: States the Court's source-and-purpose rule in its most compact form.

candidates.text: Based on the Constitution's text, the history against which that text was enacted, and congressional practice immediately following ratification
